en.newConfirm: Start over as a brand-new player?
en.photoAttached: Photo attached. Add a caption or tap send.
en.badImage: Couldn't read that image. Try a JPEG or PNG.
en.startHint: Send the first message to start. It also picks the language:
en.joinIntro: Earth has hours left. Bring one thing, and fly to the Moon from your phone.
en.nicknamePh: What should the crew call you?
en.phoneHint: The number your iPhone uses for iMessage.
en.scanSteps: Messages opens with the text ready. Just tap send.
en.iMessageNote: ⚠️ Send it from your phone number, not your email. If nothing happens: iPhone Settings › Apps › Messages › Send & Receive › "Start New Conversations From" → pick your number, delete this chat, and send again.
en.privacy: Your number is only used to connect iMessage.
en.err_full: The rocket is full. Ask the team to play on the spare phone.
en.err_not_logged_in: Boarding is paused right now. Ask the team to help you join.
en.err_registration_unavailable: Boarding is paused right now. Ask the team to help you join.
en.err_no_line: This phone couldn't be connected to iMessage. Try another phone.
en.err_too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
en.err_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
en.phoneWillUse: We will register {phone}. It must be exactly the number ticked in iPhone Settings › Messages › Send & Receive.
en.noReply: Nothing yet? Usually the number doesn't match. You registered {phone}. On the iPhone, open Settings › Apps › Messages › Send & Receive: the ticked number must be exactly this one. A reply saying "didn't recognize yours" means the same thing.

zh.newConfirm: 以新玩家身份重新开始？
zh.photoAttached: 已附上照片。可以加一句说明，或直接发送。
zh.notDelivered: 发送失败，请检查服务器。
zh.badImage: 读不了这张图片，换一张 JPEG 或 PNG 试试。
zh.startHint: 发第一条消息开始游戏（同时决定语言）：
zh.bridgeTitle: 最后一班火箭 · 舰桥
zh.joinIntro: 地球只剩几个小时。带上一样东西，用手机飞往月球。
zh.phoneHint: 你的 iPhone 上 iMessage 使用的号码。
zh.scanTitle: 用 iPhone 相机扫一扫
zh.scanSteps: 会打开"信息"并填好内容，点发送就行。
zh.orText: 或者用 iMessage 发送 {text} 到 {number}
zh.paired: 已连接！正在打开你的舰桥……
zh.iMessageNote: ⚠️ 请用手机号发送，不要用邮箱。如果发了没反应：iPhone 设置 › App › 信息 › 发送与接收 › "开始新对话时使用" → 选你的手机号，删掉这个对话后重新发送。
zh.privacy: 你的号码只用于连接 iMessage。
zh.err_full: 火箭满员了。请找工作人员用备用手机来玩。
zh.err_not_logged_in: 登船暂时暂停，请找工作人员帮你加入。
zh.err_registration_unavailable: 登船暂时暂停，请找工作人员帮你加入。
zh.err_no_line: 这个号码暂时无法连接 iMessage，请换一部手机试试。
zh.err_too_many: 尝试次数太多了，请等几分钟再试。
zh.err_generic: 出了点问题，请稍后再试。
zh.phoneWillUse: 将登记 {phone}。它必须和 iPhone 设置 › 信息 › 发送与接收 里打勾的号码完全一样。
zh.noReply: 还没反应？多半是号码对不上。你登记的是 {phone}。请在 iPhone 上打开 设置 › App › 信息 › 发送与接收：打勾的号码必须和它完全一样。如果收到 "didn't recognize yours" 的回复，也是这个原因。
